chunks: And the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family, said:

Indeed, Allah, the Exalted, has one hundred and twenty-four thousand prophets. I am their master, their most excellent, and their most honored before Allah, the Mighty and Majestic. And every prophet had a successor whom he designated by the command of Allah, exalted is His mention. Verily, my successor, ʿAlī ibn Abī Ṭālib عليه السلام, is surely their master, their most excellent, and their most honored before Allah, the Mighty and Majestic.

key_terms.أَكْرَمُهُمْ عَلَى اللَّهِ: the most honored of them before Allah
key_terms.مِائَةَ أَلْفِ نَبِيٍّ وَ أَرْبَعَةً وَ: one hundred and twenty-four thousand prophets
key_terms.وَصِيِّي عَلِيَّ بْنَ أَبِي طَالِبٍ: my successor is ʿAlī ibn Abī Ṭālib

ai.seo_question: What does this hadith say about the number of prophets and the status of Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام as the Prophet’s wasi?
ai.summary: This hadith affirms the vast number of prophets sent by Allah and declares the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله as the foremost among them. It also states that each prophet had a wasi appointed by Allah’s command, and that the Prophet’s wasi, ʿAlī ibn Abī Ṭālib عليه السلام, is the greatest and most honored among all the successors.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.5407 - The Messenger of Allah (swt) (peace be upon him and his family) said:

"Indeed, Allah (swt), the Exalted, has one hundred and twenty-four thousand prophets.
I am the master, the best, and the most honored of them before Allah (swt), the Mighty and Majestic.
Every prophet had a successor whom he appointed by the command of Allah (swt), the Exalted in His remembrance.
Verily, my successor, Ali ibn Abi Talib (as), is the master, the best, and the most honored among all of their successors before Allah (swt), the Mighty and Majestic."
